citation: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. 2022: ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model. DOI:10.25921/fd45-gt74. Accessed 2026-10-02.
boundarySource: INEGI retained Mexico state geometry, 32 states
method: Native 60 arc-second ETOPO2022 cell-centre float DEM, no resampling. ContourPy 500m contours clipped to retained INEGI national land union. Display lines simplified by 0.002 degrees and rounded to 6 decimal places. The retained INEGI boundary is already geographic and is used directly; the existing Mexico renderer applies its map projection after GeoJSON loading.
limitations: 2022 is the model edition, not a uniform observation year.
60 arc-second grid and 500m contour interval are for national comparison; they do not give survey-grade site elevations or exact summit heights.
Negative valid land elevations are retained; NoData is masked before any numeric transformation.
Selecting a line reports its contour level, not a state mean, river gradient, or measured elevation at arbitrary locations.
Sea-floor contours are excluded by the national land clip.
Grid min/max are values of native cells selected by a generalized land boundary, not national land extrema; coastal cells may contain mixed marine and terrestrial elevations.
decoderMethod: GeoTIFF.js 3.0.5 exact native window read; no resampling or integer casting
